subject.title: [Bug]: Mattermost interaction token forgeable via hardcoded HMAC derivation key

question: Should Mattermost interaction signing move to a durable configured/provisioned secret, or should existing deployments intentionally fail closed until operators configure one?
rationale: Both choices change the security boundary and upgrade behavior for existing Mattermost button deployments, and automation should not choose the credential model for maintainers.

options.title: Require durable credential provisioning
options.body: Add or use a supported persistent per-account signing secret path with setup, SecretRef/config, docs, and upgrade proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Accept explicit fail-closed upgrade
options.body: Require operators to configure a Mattermost interaction signing secret and make the failure mode clear in code, docs, and tests before landing.

options.title: Pause for a replacement fix
options.body: If the current candidate branch remains conflicting or too risky, sponsor a narrow replacement PR once the credential model is chosen.

recommendation.title: Require durable credential provisioning
recommendation.body: Add or use a supported persistent per-account signing secret path with setup, SecretRef/config, docs, and upgrade proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently hardened the same Mattermost interaction authorization path and have current-main history on the relevant files.
